# The "Best" Feature of Every US State (Trust Me On This)

**Alabama** - Roll Tide Memorial Highway Shrines: Nothing says "safe driving" like elaborate roadside monuments to college football that require you to take your eyes off the road to properly appreciate the craftsmanship.

**Alaska** - Summer Mosquitoes: Who needs sleep when you can experience clouds of bloodsucking insects so thick they're nicknamed the "Alaska state bird"? It's like free acupuncture that follows you everywhere!

**Arizona** - Phoenix in August: A delightful 120°F hellscape where you can fry eggs on the sidewalk and experience third-degree burns from your seatbelt buckle. Desert living at its finest!

**Arkansas** - The Fouke Monster Museum: Finally, a tourist attraction dedicated to a definitely-real creature from a 1970s mockumentary. Your tax dollars at work!

**California** - $4,000/month Studio Apartments: Nothing builds character like paying Manhattan prices to live in a converted broom closet in Oakland with six roommates and a "charming" mold problem.

**Colorado** - Aggressively Outdoorsy Culture: Love being shamed for not summiting a 14er before breakfast? Enjoy conversations that only consist of Subaru models and craft IPA IBUs? You'll fit right in!

**Connecticut** - New Haven Pizza Snobbery: Residents will fight you to the death over which coal-fired pizza joint is "authentic" while both taste exactly the same to anyone from outside a 5-mile radius.

**Delaware** - Being Delaware: The state so forgettable that its main feature is technically existing. Great for incorporation paperwork though!

**Florida** - Florida Man: A never-ending parade of methamphetamine-fueled chaos and alligator-related incidents that make the evening news a must-watch horror comedy.

**Georgia** - Atlanta Traffic: Why experience a 30-minute commute when you can enjoy a soul-crushing 3-hour parking lot experience on I-285? Bonus: you get to breathe that thick, humid smog!

**Hawaii** - Volcanic Fog (Vog): Breathing sulfur dioxide is probably good for you, right? It's natural! Enjoy your chronic respiratory irritation in paradise!

**Idaho** - Potato Identity Crisis: An entire state whose personality is a root vegetable. The license plates have potatoes. The gift shops sell potato plushies. It's totally not sad!

**Illinois** - Chicago Political Corruption Heritage: Why settle for boring, functional government when you can have a rich tradition of indicted governors? Four out of the last ten went to prison—that's consistency!

**Indiana** - Gary, Indiana: Featured in "The Music Man" as a cautionary tale and somehow got worse from there. Great for urban exploration if you enjoy tetanus!

**Iowa** - The Butter Cow: Every year at the state fair, someone sculpts a life-size cow from butter, and everyone pretends this is normal and interesting.

**Kansas** - Absolute Flatness: Why waste time with interesting topography when you can watch your dog run away for three days straight? The sunsets are nice because there's literally nothing else to look at!

**Kentucky** - Bourbon-Soaked Everything: A state culture so dominated by whiskey that even the tourists attractions are just "places where bourbon happened." Very healthy!

**Louisiana** - Swamp Ass Climate: Experience 100% humidity year-round! Your clothes will never be dry again! Mold grows on everything! It's "atmospheric"!

**Maine** - Stephen King's Inspiration: Your state is so unsettling that it spawned decades of horror novels. Tourists come specifically to feel creeped out. Branding!

**Maryland** - Old Bay Cult: A seasoning so aggressively marketed that Marylanders put it on ice cream, tattoo it on their bodies, and make it their entire personality.

**Massachusetts** - Massholes: The state's driving culture is so aggressive they literally nicknamed themselves after it and wear it as a badge of honor. Charming!

**Michigan** - Flint Water Crisis Merch: Nothing says "tourist destination" like commemorative t-shirts about lead poisoning and government negligence.

**Minnesota** - "Minnesota Nice": Passive aggression elevated to an art form where everyone smiles while secretly judging you. "Oh, that's different!" means "You're going to hell."

**Mississippi** - Consistently Last in Everything: Education? 50th. Healthcare? 50th. Economic opportunity? 50th. At least you're #1 at being #50!

**Missouri** - Meth Capital Pride: Why be known for BBQ or the Gateway Arch when you can lead the nation in rural methamphetamine production?

**Montana** - Unabomber Tourism: Yes, there are actual tours to Ted Kaczynski's cabin site. Nothing weird about turning a terrorist's hideout into a roadside attraction!

**Nebraska** - Carhenge: Someone looked at Stonehenge and thought, "What if we made this, but worse and with spray-painted cars?" Truly inspired.

**Nevada** - Gambling Addiction Infrastructure: An entire state economy built on exploiting statistical illiteracy and human weakness. But hey, no income tax!

**New Hampshire** - "Live Free or Die" Libertarians: Nothing says "freedom" like aggressive tax avoidance and trying to abolish driver's licenses. Society is overrated anyway!

**New Jersey** - Turnpike Rest Stops: The state's crowning achievement is highway rest stops, which tells you everything you need to know. Also, you can't pump your own gas like an adult.

**New Mexico** - Breaking Bad Tourism: Your state's biggest cultural export is a TV show about a meth-cooking chemistry teacher. The gift shops sell blue candy "meth." Super classy!

**New York** - Upstate vs. NYC Mutual Loathing: Why be one functional state when you can be two regions that despise each other locked in an eternal bitter marriage?

**North Carolina** - BBQ Civil War: The state is literally divided into violently opposed vinegar-based vs. tomato-based BBQ factions. People take this more seriously than actual politics.

**North Dakota** - Williston Oil Boom Hellscape: Transform a quiet town into a lawless, overpriced nightmare of man-camps and traffic! Economic opportunity has never looked so dystopian!

**Ohio** - Cedar Point Vomit Central: The state's main attraction is a place specifically designed to make you motion sick. "Roller Coaster Capital of the World" is not the flex you think it is.

**Oklahoma** - Tornado Alley Prime Real Estate: Why live somewhere boring and safe when you can play Russian roulette with F5 tornadoes every spring? Keeps life exciting!

**Oregon** - Portland's Aggressive Weirdness: "Keep Portland Weird" has evolved into "making normal people uncomfortable is our civic duty." Enjoy your artisanal taxidermy coffee shop!

**Pennsylvania** - Centralia Mine Fire: A town so contaminated by an underground coal fire that's been burning since 1962 that it inspired Silent Hill. Still technically not evacuated!

**Rhode Island** - Inferiority Complex: The state is so small and insecure that it gave itself the longest official name: "State of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations" (recently shortened because, well, that last word).

**South Carolina** - Myrtle Beach: Dubbed the "Redneck Riviera," it's like Florida distilled into pure concentrated trashiness. All the humidity, all the bad tattoos, unlimited mini-golf!

**South Dakota** - Mt. Rushmore: We took a sacred indigenous mountain and carved dead presidents' faces into it, then act confused why some people find this tacky.

**Tennessee** - Nashville Bachelorette Party Apocalypse: Broadway is now just an endless convoy of drunk women in matching t-shirts riding pedal taverns. This is somehow the city's main industry now.

**Texas** - Texas: The state is so far up its own ass about being Texas that "Texas" itself is the worst feature. Everything's bigger, including the ego!

**Utah** - 3.2% Beer Laws: Nothing says "freedom" like the state government protecting you from regular-strength beer. Thank goodness someone's thinking of the children!

**Vermont** - Bernie Sanders Worship: An entire state whose personality is granola, maple syrup, and one elderly socialist senator. The bumper stickers outnumber the residents.

**Virginia** - Civil War Battlefield Tourism: Base your entire tourism economy on "come see where Americans killed other Americans!" Very uplifting!

**Washington** - Seattle Freeze: A social phenomenon where everyone is "nice" but you'll never make actual friends. Perfect for people who love passive rejection!

**West Virginia** - Mountain Top Removal Mining: Why have beautiful Appalachian mountains when you can literally blow them up? The resulting toxic sludge ponds are very aesthetic!

**Wisconsin** - Binge Drinking Culture: The state leads the nation in drunk driving and treats alcoholism as a fun personality trait. The liver failure builds character!

**Wyoming** - Not Existing: With fewer people than most cities, Wyoming is basically a tax shelter with elk. Most Americans couldn't point to it on a map if their lives depended on it.
